name: Adaptive two-pane / command-centred Writer

authority.layout_only_fields: React may format dates/ranges and labels but may not derive authoritative data values

sources.name: D2 archive student.name
sources.last_tutorial_date: first item from D2 canonical newest-first tutorial history; custom_date only
sources.last_tutorial_type: first item from D2 canonical newest-first tutorial history; tutorial_type only

student_read_model.missing_value_semantics: render em dash; never infer an unavailable authoritative value from an unrelated timestamp

display.course: compact Start – End range; include years when range crosses years
display.attendance: integer percent only; no progress bars

transitions: browse no student -> browse selected student
browse selected student -> write New via explicit tutorial-type action
browse selected student -> write Revision via authoritative history row
write -> browse selected student through discard/back; dirty state requires discard confirmation
tests: recognized verbose GEL overall levels project to compact CEFR codes before reaching React
tutorial history visible columns are exactly Date/Type/Level/Teacher
Revision eligibility remains backend-authoritative but is not a permanent visible grid column
exceptional blocked Revision produces contextual error rather than silent no-op

cefr_level_display.rule: Recognized CEFR levels are displayed as compact canonical codes only (A0, A1-, A1, A1+, ... C2+).
cefr_level_display.authority: Rust writer_tauri_app_service projects archive source text through gel-core CefrLevel parsing; React does not strip or reinterpret level text.
cefr_level_display.source_preservation: Archive/source strings remain unchanged in authoritative source state; this is a view-model-only projection.
cefr_level_display.unknown_value_semantics: Unrecognized nonblank source values are preserved verbatim rather than guessed or truncated.

tutorial_history_revision_affordance.normal_interaction: Double-click any tutorial row to request Revision opening.
tutorial_history_revision_affordance.authority: revisionAvailable/authorityStatus remain safe backend/read-model data used only to fail closed on exceptional authority blocks; they are not routine visible status.
tutorial_history_revision_affordance.blocked_semantics: If authority blocks Revision, show a contextual error and keep the tutorial read-only; do not expose a permanent eligibility column.
tutorial_history_revision_affordance.reason: Revision eligibility is effectively universal in normal operation, so a permanent column adds noise without aiding the dominant workflow.

strict_acceptance: PASS=23 SKIP=0 FAIL=0; RELEASE GATE: PASS
